definitions.gloss: ear, nose, and throat department; ENT; otorhinolaryngology
definitions.explanation: The medical specialty dealing with conditions of the ear, nose, and throat, or the hospital department that handles these. Short for {耳鼻咽喉科|じびいんこうか}.

examples.japanese: {耳鼻科|じびか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go to the ENT department.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{耳鼻科|じびか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I visited the ENT doctor because my hay fever was bad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{耳鼻科|じびか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: My ear wasn't feeling right, so I made an appointment at a nearby ENT clinic.

notes:
Short for ⟦{耳鼻咽喉科|じびいんこうか}→耳鼻咽喉科：23659_jibiinkouka⟧ (otorhinolaryngology). In everyday Japanese, the abbreviated form {耳鼻科|じびか} is far more common. It covers conditions of the ears, nose, throat, and sinuses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耳鼻科|じびか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the ENT
- {耳鼻科|じびか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to see an ENT doctor
- {耳鼻科|じびか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: ENT doctor
- {耳鼻科|じびか}{医|い}: ENT specialist
